name: Miller's Marketing Group
tagline: An environment where professionals connect organically.
description: Marketing, sponsorship, and networking opportunities for Florida's personal injury professional community.
disclaimer: MMG is not a law firm or medical provider and does not provide legal or medical advice. Participation in MMG marketing programs or events does not guarantee referrals, clients, cases, or business outcomes.

valueProps.title: The right room
valueProps.body: Curated gatherings that bring together people with shared professional interests, then make it easy to begin a real conversation.

valueProps.title: Organic connections
valueProps.body: From bowling to lunch and learns, each setting gives relationships room to develop naturally without forced networking.

valueProps.title: No pressure
valueProps.body: The best relationships grow when people feel comfortable enough to have a real conversation. Show up, meet good people, see what happens.

audiences.title: Personal Injury Attorneys
audiences.body: Meet medical providers, vendors, and fellow professionals who understand the personal injury community.

audiences.title: Medical Providers
audiences.body: Build visibility and professional relationships with attorneys and industry partners across South Florida.

audiences.title: Sponsors and Vendors
audiences.body: Support memorable events and introduce your brand to a focused professional audience.
